newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler January vehicle output up 6.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler January vehicle output up 6.3 pct.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said iit produced 244,499 cars and trucks worldwide in January, a 6.3 percent increase over the 230,089 vehicles it built a year earlier.
Chrysler said it built 182,408 trucks during January, up 9.8 percent from 166,114 a year earlier. Chrysler's January car production came to 62,091, down 2.9 percent from 63,975 a year earlier.
The January totals include 8,158 trucks built in Austria, up from 7,385 a year earlier. The remainder of Chrysler's vehciles are built in the United States, Canada and Mexico.
